column1: The Group’s policy requires the review of individual financial assets that are above materiality thresholds at least annually or more regularly when individual
circumstances require. Impairment allowances on individually assessed accounts are determined by an evaluation of the incurred loss at reporting date on
a case-by-case basis, and are applied to all individually significant accounts. The assessment normally encompasses collateral held (including re-
confirmation of its enforceability) and the anticipated receipts for that individual account.
